visual_action: A young man with dark, curly hair, wearing a blue sweater, sits in a living room and lip-syncs to a song. Text overlays appear on screen, creating a fictional conversation about voting.

cast.name: Unnamed man
cast.evidence: He is the only person who appears on screen, acting out the scenario and lip-syncing.

cast.name: Democratic Party
cast.evidence: The video was posted by the official @democrats account and encourages viewers to 'vote blue'.

on_screen_text.text: “So are you voting in the midterm elections?”
“I’m voting blue because reproductive rights, LGBTQ+ rights, and the right to privacy are all on the ballot.”
“Me too! I just registered to vote at IWillVote.com!”

spoken_summary: There is no dialogue in the video. The audio consists of the song 'Margaritaville' by Jimmy Buffett, with the audible lyrics being 'Some people claim that there's a woman to blame, but I know it's nobody's fault.' A conversation is conveyed entirely through on-screen text, where one person asks about voting in the midterms and another responds that they are 'voting blue' to protect reproductive, LGBTQ+, and privacy rights. The video concludes with a call to action to register at IWillVote.com.
audio_music: The song 'Margaritaville' by Jimmy Buffett plays continuously throughout the video. The music has an upbeat, relaxed, and folksy-pop feel, which contrasts with the serious political topics presented in the on-screen text.
editing_pacing: The video consists of a single, static shot with no cuts, zooms, or other editing effects. The only changes are the text overlays that appear sequentially.
central_claim: One should vote for the Democratic party in the midterm elections to protect fundamental rights, and can register to do so at IWillVote.com.
intended_effect: To encourage viewers to register to vote and support Democratic candidates by framing the election as critical for defending reproductive, LGBTQ+, and privacy rights.
